summary.text: Lynn Evans, listed by Ballotpedia as K. Lynn Evans, is a Republican Iowa state senator who has represented District 3 since 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
An educator, he previously worked as a school superintendent.

paragraphs.text: Lynn Evans graduated from Aurelia High School and earned a B.S. in physical education and biology from Westmar College in 1986, an M.A. in educational leadership and administration from Drake University in 1996, and an Ed.S. in the same field from Drake in 2003.

His career experience includes working as an adjunct instructor with Buena Vista University, a customer service specialist, and superintendent of the Alta-Aurelia Community School District and the Hartley Melvin Sanborn school district.
He has served as vice president of the Alta Kiwanis Club, as president and vice president of the Hartley Lion's Club, and on the Alta-Aurelia Community Education Foundation Board.
Evans assumed office in the Iowa State Senate on January 3, 2023, and advanced from the Republican primary on June 2, 2026.
